content: Melvin-Koushki notes that the letters between Rashīd al-Dīn and Ṣadr al-Dīn Turka are probably inauthentic and datable to the Timurid period (Morton), and asks why it mattered in 9th/15th-century Iran to posit a close relationship between the two. He calls a defence of their authenticity unpersuasive.
